mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of supply chain disruption (indicated by declining industrial production), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is declining and the regime is supply chain disruption, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion (indicated by rising GDP growth), consumer and business spending accelerates, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is rising and the regime is early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A negative change in industrial production (INDPRO) consistently signals supply-side weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
